title: Cimmino 2013 · Two-point tactile acuity
citation: Cimmino et al. (2013). Plasticity of body representations after surgical arm elongation in an achondroplasic patient. Restorative Neurology and Neuroscience, 31(3), 287–298.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.context: Companion outcome in the surgical arm-elongation case study.
published_method.stimulus: Use a Med Core adjustable aesthesiometer with the tips oriented vertically on the ventral arm just above the elbow. Blindfold the participant.
published_method.procedure: Randomly intermix one and two contacts. Record the participant’s spoken count. The smallest separation correctly identified on five successive two-point presentations defines threshold.

staircase.reported_update: Decrease after correct response. Increase after error.
staircase.caveat: The source describes one update rule for two starting directions.

implementation_gaps: Requires an adjustable calibrated aesthesiometer, standardized tactile contact and an operator-controlled staircase with spoken one-versus-two capture.
Ascending-only update, exact trial count, pressure and contact duration are unresolved.
